items.title: v2.1.4：新增 CrowLLM / QuWork 两个供应商，CodeBuddy GLM-5.4 上架
items.body: CrowLLM：one-hub 聚合站，贴 API Key 即用，30 个 :free 免费模型（GLM 5.3 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731、MiniMax M3.1 Flash 等）。QuWork：手机号短信登录或粘 llm_token，带积分配额卡、每日签到、微信绑定与邀请码激活——注意它拒绝非中国大陆 IP（HTTP 405），海外服务器需给该连接配国内代理。模型目录：CodeBuddy CN 新增 GLM-5.4（0.69x），Loomy 新增 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017、下架 V4 Flash 0731 与 MiMo V2.5。修复：额度卡「最早到期」三面口径统一、Loomy 四个模型不再冒充能读图、Codex 发图 400。配置零迁移。

items.title: v2.1.1：百度搭子 / WPS 灵犀 现在能在供应商列表里看到了
items.body: v2.1.0 新增的 DuMate（百度搭子）和 WPS 灵犀此前没有列表入口，只能手动输网址进详情页。现在它们正常显示在列表底部的 Web Cookie Providers 分组，点卡片即可添加（搭子扫码、灵犀抓 cookie）。配置与数据零迁移。
items.titleEn: v2.1.1: DuMate and WPS Lingxi now show up in the provider list
items.bodyEn: The DuMate (Baidu Dazi) and WPS Lingxi providers added in v2.1.0 had no card in the provider list and could only be reached by URL. They now appear in the Web Cookie Providers group at the bottom of the list — click the card to add them (DuMate by QR scan, Lingxi by cookie capture). No config or data migration.

items.title: v2.1.0：新增 DuMate / WPS 灵犀 / DeepAI Code 三个供应商
items.body: DuMate 扫码即用、WPS 灵犀抓一次 cookie 即可（含每日签到）、DeepAI Code 面板内登录并带 Theos 免费额度。同一版里自动更新不再打断正在生成的回答：停服前会等请求跑完，等太久就推迟到下一个窗口。配置、连接、数据零迁移。
items.titleEn: v2.1.0: three new providers — DuMate, WPS Lingxi, DeepAI Code
items.bodyEn: DuMate works by scanning a QR code, WPS Lingxi needs a one-time cookie capture (with daily check-in), and DeepAI Code signs in from the dashboard with Theos free quota. Auto-update no longer cuts off in-flight completions: it waits for requests to finish and defers to the next window if the wait is too long. No config, connection or data migration.

items.title: v2.0.0：清掉一批「只在浏览器里炸」的崩溃，配置零迁移
items.body: 本版修掉四处运行时未定义符号导致的崩溃（Loomy 页白屏、网页抓取/搜索刷新令牌、Gemini Decision 测试按钮 500），并把这类检查接进了发布流程。没有破坏性变更，连接与数据零迁移。
items.titleEn: v2.0.0: a batch of browser-only crashes fixed, zero migration
items.bodyEn: Four runtime ReferenceError crashes are fixed (blank Loomy page, token refresh on web fetch/search, 500 on the Gemini Decision test button), and this class of defect is now gated in CI. No breaking changes; no connection or data migration.

items.title: 紧急修复：Loomy 供应商页白屏
items.body: v1.9.8 里 Loomy 供应商详情页会整块打不开（客户端 ReferenceError，fnOS 内嵌窗口显示通用错误页）。请升级到 v1.9.9；其他供应商页不受影响，连接与数据无需任何迁移。
items.titleEn: Hotfix: Loomy provider page went blank
items.bodyEn: On v1.9.8 the Loomy provider detail page fails to render entirely (client-side ReferenceError; the fnOS embedded window shows its generic error page). Upgrade to v1.9.9. Other providers are unaffected and no connection or data migration is needed.

items.title: Trae 拆线：国内 / 国际两条供应商 + 每日签到
items.body: 账号本就不互通，现在拆成两张卡，登录不再选站点；老连接零迁移。新增每日签到领积分与额度查询（套餐名 + 权益包明细），纯文本对话改走轻量直连通道。
items.titleEn: Trae split into CN / Intl providers + daily check-in
items.bodyEn: Two account pools that never talked are now two provider cards — no site picker, existing connections unchanged. Daily credit check-in and quota card (plan + packs) added; plain chat now uses the lightweight direct channel.

items.title: Meoo（秒悟）接入：阿里系新免费池
items.body: 官方 OAuth 或直接粘贴 Key 两种接入方式；模型目录实时同步网关；用量卡显示积分余额，每日登录可领积分。
items.titleEn: Meoo added: a new free pool from Alibaba Cloud
items.bodyEn: Official OAuth or paste-a-key onboarding; the model catalog mirrors the live gateway; the quota card shows your points balance with a daily login claim.

items.title: Loomy 每日赠送积分优先：单账号烧穿调度
items.body: 多账号时锁定一个号把当日 5000 赠送积分烧完才换号，绝不平摊；烧尽自动关闭、次日 0 点自动重开。开关在 Loomy 供应商页，默认关闭。
items.titleEn: Loomy daily grant first: single-account burn scheduling
items.bodyEn: Traffic sticks to one account until its 5000 daily points are fully burned, never spread thin; drained accounts auto-close and reopen at midnight. Toggle on the Loomy provider page, off by default.

items.title: 修复：只有思考没有正文的回复不再被客户端丢弃
items.body: 流式结束前自动把思考提升为正文；组合模式判定零可用内容时自动顺延下一模型。Hermes Agent 等严格客户端受益。
items.titleEn: Fixed: reasoning-only responses no longer dropped
items.bodyEn: Thinking content is promoted to the reply body before the stream ends; combo mode advances to the next model on zero usable content. Strict clients like Hermes Agent benefit.

items.title: 新功能：隐私脱敏——让上游看不到你的密钥
items.body: 连接详情里打开「隐私脱敏」，出站请求里的 API Key、私钥、JWT 会被替换成占位符，模型回显的内容自动还原成原文。默认关闭，只对你不信任的上游开启。
items.titleEn: New: privacy redaction — keep your keys away from upstreams
items.bodyEn: Turn on “Privacy redaction” in a connection and API keys, private keys and JWTs in the outbound request become placeholders; anything the model echoes back is restored before it reaches you. Off by default — enable it only for upstreams you do not trust.
